text: The patient management portal shall streamline appointment scheduling across medical departments,
and the system shall reduce check-in wait times.
The system should authenticate medical staff using multi-factor authentication.
The application user session timeout shall be 15 minutes of inactivity.
User passwords shall never expire once assigned by the administrator.
The database query response time must be fast and user-friendly under peak loads.
Audit logs shall be stored in an encrypted vault.
The application user session timeout shall be 60 minutes of inactivity.
User passwords shall expire every 90 days to comply with enterprise security policies.
The automated test suite shall verify that authentication tokens are cryptographically signed.
The system shall display a customized background theme on holiday weekends.
